
2. Use the foldertool to navigate to the relevant folder and extract the relevant data.

   ```
   foldertool /path/to/folder lab_data.txt
   ```

   This will navigate to the folder named "lab_data.txt" and extract the data from the relevant folder.

3. Use the memory-read skill to read the specified value from the relevant file.

   ```
   memory-read lab_data.txt /path/to/file/name value
   ```

   This will read the specified value from the file named "lab_data.txt" in the current working directory.
